acceptanceCriteria: the cold build is excluded from (or separately budgeted outside) the per-mutant limit, with retained cold/warm timings
a regression shows a loaded host no longer produces a not-run on the first mutant solely from the cold build
body: Found by the V1-0547 spike (PR #963, 2026-10-16). The per-run limit is wall time / (maxMutants+1), and each discrimination request starts with an empty build cache, so its first `go test` builds cold: 74.5 s cold vs 6.5 s warm at load ~60. The old 42.9 s per-run limit killed that run before a verdict. #963 fixed the test's budget; the product still charges the cold build to one mutant's run. Expected: the cold build is either done once before the per-run budget starts or budgeted separately, with the cost reported.
